ana: quick PR to clarify SDK snippets for streaming + pagination (py/ts/go). https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/914
marc: can you summarize the change set?
ana: typo — ana :) main points: async iterator examples for TS/Python, a short Go fix showing nil cursor guard, and small retry-with-jitter additions.
ryan: paste the minimal go snippet for review?
ana: here:
```go
// guard against nil cursor from API
var cursor *string = nil
for {
  resp, err := client.List(ctx, &ListParams{Cursor: cursor})
  if err != nil { return err }
  items = append(items, resp.Items...)
  if resp.Cursor == nil { break }
  cursor = resp.Cursor
}
```
marc: good. add a line about servers sometimes returning null vs empty string. saved a support ticket link in the PR.
docs-bot: Reminder: add snippet lint checks (go vet/tsc/mypy) or mark waived. CI may block merges. :robot_face:
ryan: i'll add a lightweight lint job. once green we can merge.
ana: thanks all, i'll update the PR description and merge after lint passes. :thumbsup:
